title: Evaluation sets: building, versioning and maintaining them

videos.script: An evaluation set asks the same questions of every version, so two versions can be compared. {{set}} The thirty cases so far were written from the documents. The traffic says what customers really ask. {{harvest}} The most doubted question of the week is not in the set. Customers write in keywords. And the order messages, with a name and a number, fail far more often. {{findings}} Twelve new cases keep the customers' wording, and replace every name and number with values invented for the test. {{additions}} A version is a fixed file and its hash, with its parent and the documents it was checked against. {{version}} A check catches a name pasted from a trace, and two cases a change to one document has made false. {{check}} And a third of the cases are held out, never looked at while tuning. {{split}} A set is never finished. {{end}}
